These synthetic resumes contain no real person's information. `resume.pdf` is a text PDF, `resume.docx` is a minimal valid Word document, and `resume.txt` contains their text. The other PDFs cover a blank/scanned-style page, 31 pages, and password encryption. `stalled.worker.ts` deliberately blocks to exercise worker termination without waiting 20 seconds. No fixture or ordinary test calls a paid model.
